scope: Official pages fetched 2026-11-01 for the rows listed under 'verified'. Every other row is Unverified: its prize value is left blank on the site and it is flagged. Ledger values (upstream data.js, last checked 2026-08-19) are never copied into verified fields.

statusDefinitions.verified: An official page was fetched on 2026-11-01 and the stated value matched.
statusDefinitions.partial: An official page was fetched and some fields matched; other fields were not confirmed.
statusDefinitions.conflict: An official page was fetched and contradicts the ledger on at least one field. The official value is shown.
statusDefinitions.broken: The ledger link does not show the claimed contest.
statusDefinitions.unverified: Not checked against an official page in this review. Prize blank; flagged.

mlb-beat-the-streak.prize: US$5,600,000 headline. Winner's choice of a 30-year annuity of US$186,667 per year, or a lump sum of the estimated present value (US$3,000,000 as of 12 Mar 2026). No purchase necessary; 21+; US and Canada excluding Quebec.
mlb-beat-the-streak.finding: Prize confirmed. Official rules say the contest starts about 24 Mar 2026 and ends 'upon conclusion of the final game of the 2026 MLB regular season'. The ledger still says live (checked 2026-08-19). The official end condition has passed as of 2026-11-01. Status needs review.

metaculus.prize: Sample of live tournaments on page: $3,400 to $50,000 prize pools. Participation free; cash prizes for accuracy.
metaculus.finding: Page states 'You can participate for free and win cash prizes for being accurate' and lists prize pools from $3,400 to $50,000. The ledger lower bound of $3,000 is not shown on the page sample. Prize blank for the ledger range.

cbs-pro-pickem.finding: Official rules (2026): free to play, no purchase or entry fee; sign-up from 20 Jul 2026; Challenge period 9 Sep 2026 to 10 Jan 2027; 18 weekly periods. Prize amounts are in later sections of the rules, which were not read, so the ledger prize figure ($1K/week, $5K season, $100K perfect) is unverified and left blank.

devpost.prize: Sample on the hackathons listing page: $2,500 to $1,000,000 in prizes across the live events shown.
devpost.finding: Listing page shows live hackathons with prizes from $2,500 (Learn AR with SPECS) to $1,000,000 (Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026). The ledger lower bound of $10,000 is not supported by this sample. The ledger's top value ($685,000) is not on this page. Prize blank for the ledger range.

kaggle.prize: Prize pools on the official Competitions page: $35,000, $100,000 and $450,000 among the featured and hackathon sections shown.
kaggle.finding: Official page lists live prize pools of $35,000 to $450,000. The ledger says 'commonly $5,000 to $100,000+'. The ledger range is understated. Official values shown instead.

checkmate-gaming.prize: Free tournaments page lists prizes of $40, $100, $120 and $1,500 per tournament (listing checked 2026-11-01).
checkmate-gaming.finding: Page states 'Totally free to enter with real cash prizes'. The ledger range '$10 to $180' is contradicted by the page, which shows $40 to $1,500 on live listings. The ledger also says the platform runs paid-entry wager matches; those are not on this page.

draft-pro.finding: Operator press release (PR Newswire, 8 Apr 2026): $1,000,000 Perfect Draft for the 2026 NFL Draft; entries close before the 23 Apr 2026 first round. The ledger lists status 'live' and also says the $1M closed 23 Apr 2026. The current $10,000 NBA/NHL prize is not verified. Prize blank; status needs review.

dirty-dozen.finding: Ledger link https://www.gambling.com/games/dirty-dozen redirects to https://www.gambling.com/games, a free online casino games page. No Dirty Dozen contest appears. irregularities.title: Repo was a placeholder (README only), with no data, site or license
irregularities.detail: Before this session, the repo contained only README.md ('# Own2'). No LICENSE file exists here or in the upstream source (karagemop466-tech/FreeMoneyApps). Reuse rights for the upstream listing data are unconfirmed. Recommend a license decision before public reuse.

irregularities.title: Upstream ledger data is stale
irregularities.detail: All 206 rows are stamped lastChecked 2026-08-19, which is 74 days old at 2026-11-01. The upstream audit notes say photo awards have annual deadlines, so their status must be re-checked. Treat every ledger value as unverified until checked.

irregularities.title: Policy conflict: sportsbook and casino entries in the ledger
irregularities.detail: The source's stated policy excludes casino products and any contest requiring a gambling-operator (bookmaker, sportsbook, real-money DFS) account. Yet Fanatics Sportsbook (fanatics-survivor) and Andy's Bet Club (andys-predictor) are listed as live, and gambling.com (dirty-dozen) is listed as a live free game. Fanatics and dirty-dozen are both in the 'featured' list.

irregularities.title: Broken link: dirty-dozen
irregularities.detail: The ledger link redirects to a casino games page. No Dirty Dozen contest is shown there.

irregularities.detail: Ledger says $10 to $180 per free tournament. The official page shows $40 to $1,500 on live listings.

irregularities.title: Prize range understated: kaggle
irregularities.detail: Ledger says 'commonly $5,000 to $100,000+'. The official Competitions page shows live pools of $35,000 to $450,000.

irregularities.title: Status: mlb-beat-the-streak
irregularities.detail: Official rules end the contest with the 2026 MLB regular season. Ledger still lists it as live. Prize ($5.6M headline) is confirmed.

irregularities.title: Category blurb conflicts with policy
irregularities.detail: The 'Fantasy & sports picks' category blurb says 'Daily fantasy freerolls and sweepstakes sportsbooks'. Sweepstakes and sportsbooks are excluded by the source's own policy.

irregularities.title: Misattributed links: 9 third-party FPL leagues point to the official Fantasy Premier League site
irregularities.detail: football-mad, fantasy-arena, lazyfpl, fplhub, bona-fide, olka, fplmanager-india, fplstore and pitchbooking are third-party leagues whose signup link is the official Fantasy Premier League site. Fantasy Football Scout entries: ffs-fpl links to the official FPL site, ffs-ucl to UEFA's Champions League Fantasy page, ffs-efl to the EFL fantasy page, and ffs-tattico to the third-party Fantasy Football Scout site (labelled official).

irregularities.title: Affiliate-only sources for prize figures
irregularities.detail: roboforex-demo, fbs-pro-demo and npbfx-demo cite affiliate-tier sources only for specific prize figures. The source's own rule says affiliate sources may be secondary colour, never the sole basis for a figure.

irregularities.title: Tier labels: non-operator sites labelled 'official'
irregularities.detail: Sources labelled 'official' include gambling.com, Oddspedia (betting site), Fantasy Football Scout (third-party media), Darts Corner (retailer), Motocross Action (magazine) and PR Newswire (press release, not rules).

irregularities.title: Annual photo awards may have closed
irregularities.detail: Seven photo competitions are listed live with annual cycles. Current deadlines are unverified.

irregularities.title: Promo and join codes in ledger data
irregularities.detail: Several third-party leagues list join codes. Verification flags are false or null for most. Codes are not published on this site.

irregularities.title: Undocumented count definitions
irregularities.detail: The upstream page shows '62 iOS options'. In the data this equals entries that include iOS and whose status is not 'ended'. The page does not say so. Reconciled, not an error.

The removed entries are not in the listing data. Entries named as needing re-check (draft-pro, fftoday-draft, splash-mock) remain. See R5.
